tools.name: vat_check
tools.description: Validate a VAT number and get the registered business name and address. EU numbers via the official VIES service, UK numbers via HMRC. Use for invoicing, supplier onboarding, tax and KYB checks. Accepts e.g. IE6388047V, DE811234567, GB553557881. (cost: 2 credits)

tools.name: uk_vat_check
tools.description: Validate a UK VAT registration number against the official HMRC register and return the registered business name and address. For invoicing, supplier checks and VAT reclaim. (cost: 2 credits)
